name: GDELT DOC/GEO 2.0
historical_data: DOC rolling 3 months; historical from 2017; event datasets longer
retention_limit: none stated; upstream publisher rights still apply
notes: Discovery only, never evidence. Official docs do not publish a fixed quota; observed guidance is about one request every 5 seconds and max 250 records per request. Upstream article rights must be checked before storage/display.

name: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
free_tier: free API key; no published numeric quota
notes: No general redistribution right; third-party series may be copyright-protected. Required notice: 'This product uses the FRED API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.' Verify series-level provenance.

name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
notes: Public domain except previously copyrighted photographs/illustrations; BLS emblem is a registered trademark. Key must be renewed at least yearly.

name: Eurostat
regional_restrictions: some non-EU/third-party data excluded from commercial reuse
notes: CC BY 4.0 with exceptions: third-party material, non-EU/EFTA data, some Liechtenstein/Swiss/Austrian trade data. Preserve dataset DOI/access date.

name: U.S. Federal Register API
notes: U.S. government work; 1 CFR 2.6 supports republication. API is a prototype, not the official legal edition; verify legal text against govinfo. Results capped around 2,000; use date/agency filters.

name: GOV.UK Content API
regional_restrictions: some content excludes personal data/third-party rights
notes: OGL v3 generally allows commercial reuse with attribution; page-level applicability must be confirmed. Exclude personal data, logos, third-party material.

name: SEC EDGAR APIs and filings
free_tier: free, no key; 10 requests/sec, declared User-Agent
notes: Extend the existing SEC lane, not RSS. Prioritize submissions/8-K/10-Q/10-K/Form D and full-text search; handle XBRL tags, periods, YTD, amendments, and third-party exhibits.

name: UK Companies House API
historical_data: company filings and register history varies
regional_restrictions: UK register; data protection and third-party copyright apply
notes: Public register data is provided under statutory provisions, not simply OGL; CH-generated guidance is OGL. Do not assume unrestricted commercial reuse without review. Use for company identity, officers, filings, ownership signals.

name: GLEIF LEI API
historical_data: current LEI/reference data; historical changes limited
notes: CC0 1.0. Use for entity resolution, parent/child relationships, BIC/ISIN mappings. GLEIF may change access if use undermines GLEIS principles.

name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
regional_restrictions: EU/EEA procurement; EU reuse decision applies
notes: Free search API; submitting notices needs an EU Login key. Community-reported limits: about 250 notices/request and 15,000 documents/query; verify against official docs. Preserve CPV, buyer country, notice type, values, deadlines.

name: Japan e-Stat API
historical_data: varies by survey; long series available
regional_restrictions: some third-party content may have separate rights
notes: Commercial use allowed with source credit; content terms compatible with CC BY 4.0. No published numeric rate limit; do not burst.

name: Korea OpenDART
notes: Free, official disclosure API; commercial use is strongly implied by the Public Data Act framing, but obtain written confirmation before subscriber display/redistribution. Reported limit about 20,000 requests/day.

name: Japan EDINET API
regional_restrictions: Japan; redistribution services require FSA application
notes: Free and does not itself bar commercial use, but attribution, access limits and redistribution application apply; automated pulls should run overnight. Future ISSB/IFRS taxonomy may carry separate license fees.

name: China National Bureau of Statistics
regional_restrictions: China; terms and data reuse not verified
notes: A public JSON query interface exists and changed in 2026, but official API documentation/terms were not confirmed. Treat as observation-only until terms and stability are verified; no commercial use assumption.

name: China State Council English portal
notes: No documented RSS/API found for the English policy portal; use page monitoring for titles/links first. Chinese-language gov.cn policy list is JS-rendered and blocked. Do not use browser automation until terms permit.

name: World Bank Open Data API
regional_restrictions: third-party datasets may have separate terms
notes: CC BY 4.0 for World Bank-produced datasets; attribution required; some third-party indicators are not redistributable. Do not treat as independent of underlying national sources.

name: IMF Data
notes: IMF statistical data can be used commercially with attribution/conditions, but the current copyright page says to request permission for commercial reuse; bulk automated downloading is restricted. Confirm before product use.

name: OECD Data API
notes: OECD terms generally allow commercial use with attribution for datasets; check dataset metadata for third-party rights. PISA products have special rules.

name: OpenAlex
free_tier: free; no key 10 req/sec, free key 30 req/sec
notes: CC0 data. Use for paper/author/institution discovery, not as proof of commercial deployment; abstracts may have separate publisher rights.

name: Crossref REST API
free_tier: free, no key; polite pool with mailto
notes: Most metadata is public domain/CC0; abstracts may be copyrighted. Use DOI/ROR/ORCID/funder links for entity resolution.

name: arXiv API
regional_restrictions: commercial projects must review API/bulk terms
notes: Commercial projects should review API/bulk documentation and branding rules; independent noncommercial projects have clearer use. Treat preprints as research signals, not deployment evidence.

name: Ember Electricity Data API
historical_data: yearly from 2000; monthly from 2000; capacity from 2016
notes: CC BY 4.0. Ember is a secondary compilation; do not treat agreement with EIA as independent corroboration. Read methodology before comparing.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
regional_restrictions: EU/ENTSO-E area; open data CC BY 4.0
notes: Free but manual token approval; 400 req/min; one year per standard query. Open data under CC BY 4.0 per 2023 terms.

name: UN Comtrade
paid_pricing: Premium subscription; redistribution license required above threshold
regional_restrictions: commercial redistribution of original data restricted
notes: Free tier for research/internal use; commercial redistribution of original data generally requires Premium + distribution license. Transformed/derived data may have different treatment; confirm.

name: WTO Statistics API
notes: Official WTO Timeseries API; free registration. Terms/licensing and commercial reuse not confirmed in this research; do not assume.

name: USAspending API
regional_restrictions: Dun & Bradstreet recipient data has commercial/bulk restrictions
notes: Public domain except D&B-sourced recipient names/addresses: credit required, no bulk/commercial/resale use of that subset. Use award/agency/NAICS filters.

name: Event Registry / NewsAPI.ai
historical_data: archive back to 2014; paid archive access
regional_restrictions: no redistribution/resale; no competing news aggregation service
notes: Useful for event clustering and 2014+ archive; free tier is evaluation only; commercial use requires paid plan. Event clusters are not independent corroboration.

name: SAM.gov Get Opportunities API
historical_data: active notices; archived via Data Services
notes: Official opportunity notices; key required; queries limited to one-year ranges; max 1,000/page. Terms not explicit; verify before subscriber display.

name: USAJOBS API
notes: Official search API; max 10,000 rows/query, 500/page; no published requests-per-second limit. Terms and display rights need confirmation.

name: U.S. Census Bureau API
notes: U.S. government aggregate statistics; public domain. Useful for population, housing, trade, business patterns.

name: ECB Data Portal API
regional_restrictions: terms not confirmed in this research
notes: Free API; terms/redistribution not verified here. Confirm before commercial display.

name: Data.gov CKAN API
notes: Catalog metadata only, not the data itself. Use to discover datasets; verify each dataset's own license.

name: data.europa.eu API
notes: Catalog/metadata API; dataset-level licenses govern reuse. No published rate limit; be conservative.

name: IMF PortWatch
notes: Useful for port/chokepoint disruption signals; hosted on ArcGIS REST. IMF general terms may not directly cover PortWatch; confirm license before use.

name: Semiconductor Industry Association
historical_data: press releases; WSTS full data paid
notes: Monthly global sales press releases are free; full WSTS data is paid. Industry association data is not independent of member companies.

name: USPTO PatentsView / Open Data
notes: PatentsView is transitioning to USPTO Open Data; endpoint/API status must be rechecked before design. U.S. government data generally reusable.

name: EPO Open Patent Services (OPS)
paid_pricing: about EUR 2,800/year for unlimited above quota
notes: OAuth 2.0; 4 GB/week free; X-Throttling-Control header; do not exceed fair use. Confirm display/redistribution rights before product use.

name: OpenSanctions
regional_restrictions: commercial use inside for-profit business requires paid license
notes: Data CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use requires license. yente code is MIT but data rights are separate. Use only after compliance use case is approved.

name: Government release email alerts (GovDelivery class)
notes: User-subscribed government release alerts. Subscription permission is not analysis/display/redistribution permission. Use dedicated mailbox and per-sender terms review.

name: Company IR/newsroom email alerts
notes: First-party announcements; evidence of 'the company said X', not independent verification. Do not republish attachments without rights. Requires dedicated mailbox and unsubscribe handling. This is a channel-class row (multiple senders/sites), not a single source; terms must be checked per sender/site.

name: Think-tank / research newsletter class
notes: Examples: Brookings, CSIS, Bruegel, Rhodium, MERICS. Useful for interpretation/context, not primary facts. Per-sender terms and conflict-of-interest disclosure required. This is a channel-class row (multiple senders/sites), not a single source; terms must be checked per sender/site.

name: Official policy/regulator page monitoring
retention_limit: store only discovery metadata if rights unclear
notes: For pages without API/RSS (e.g. China gov.cn, NBS releases). Check robots and terms; 401/403/429 stop; no login/paywall bypass; store link/title/hash first. This is a channel-class row (multiple senders/sites), not a single source; terms must be checked per sender/site.

name: Company IR/newsroom page monitoring
retention_limit: link/title first; body only with rights
notes: Use for IR/newsroom pages without RSS. Prefer official RSS/API when available. Do not bypass consent walls; store only discovery metadata if body rights unclear. This is a channel-class row (multiple senders/sites), not a single source; terms must be checked per sender/site.

name: Adzuna Jobs API
paid_pricing: commercial license negotiated; no public price list
regional_restrictions: 16-18 countries; free access may be a 14-day commercial trial
notes: Useful hiring/需求 signal; free tier and commercial trial terms must be confirmed. Mandatory Adzuna attribution. Do not treat job ads as payment evidence.

name: Bluesky / AT Protocol public API
regional_restrictions: personal data and content rights apply
notes: Public data without key, but personal data/GDPR/CCPA and content rights apply. Social signal only; trace back to official/primary sources. Defer until event pipeline mature.

name: NewsAPI.org
regional_restrictions: free dev only; no full text on any plan
notes: Free tier explicitly not for staging/production. GDELT is a better free discovery layer; use NewsAPI only if its publisher coverage/archive is proven necessary.

name: OICA World Sales and Production Statistics
paid_pricing: internal EUR 7,500/yr; public report EUR 22,000/yr; redistribution EUR 35,000/yr
notes: Authoritative auto production/sales but commercial licensing is expensive; use national statistics/company filings first. Free use is non-commercial with attribution.

name: IFR World Robotics
notes: Robotics installations are a real gap, but IFR data is proprietary and expensive. Use free OWID/AI Index aggregates only as context, with their own licenses.

name: IEA Data Services
free_tier: reports often CC BY 4.0; datasets not
regional_restrictions: datasets/data browser/WEO attachments excluded from CC
notes: Reports are often reusable under CC BY 4.0; datasets require separate license. Not a first-batch source; EIA/Ember/ENTSO-E cover more cheaply.

name: HKEXnews
paid_pricing: HKEX-IS Issuer Information feed; quote required
regional_restrictions: systematic retrieval requires permission; redistribution requires HKEX-IS license
notes: Terms prohibit unauthorised systematic retrieval. The undocumented titleSearch endpoint is technically available but not authorised. Use only via HKEX-IS license.

name: KOSIS OpenAPI
regional_restrictions: Korean-language terms; commercial/reuse conditions conflict with data.go.kr KOGL claim
notes: Official Korean statistics; terms conflict and foreign-company registration may be a barrier. Do not assume commercial reuse; resolve terms first.

name: X API
historical_data: recent search about 7 days; full archive enterprise
paid_pricing: pay-per-use; legacy Basic/Pro closed to new signups
notes: Expensive and limited for general discovery; not worth first batch. Social signal only; trace to primary sources.

name: Reddit Data API
notes: Free tier non-commercial; commercial use needs a contract. Useful for pain-point discovery but noisy; defer until B-lane validation.

name: Google News RSS
regional_restrictions: Google terms restrict to personal, non-commercial feed-reader use
notes: No official API; RSS is personal, non-commercial use in a feed reader, not a commercial data source. Links are opaque redirect URLs and no history. Use GDELT/licensed APIs instead.

name: Bing Search API
notes: Bing Search APIs retired 2025-08-11. Grounding with Bing Search is not a drop-in raw search API and returns model-generated responses. Do not design on it.

name: Google Programmable Search JSON API
regional_restrictions: closed to new customers; service ends 2027-01-01
notes: Closed to new customers and scheduled to end 2027-01-01. Not a sustainable discovery layer.
